==On This Day==
*Worshipers of the [[halfling]] deity [[Cyrrollalee]] celebrate [[Hearthday]].<ref name="DD-170">{{Cite book/Demihuman Deities|170}}</ref>
*Worshipers of [[Moander]] celebrate [[Balefire]].<ref name="FA-121">{{Cite book/Faiths & Avatars|121}}</ref>
*Many [[dwarven]] communities celebrate the anniversary of the blessing of [[Moradin]] that began a resurgence in the birthrate in the [[1306 DR|Year of Thunder]].<ref name="FaP-122">{{Cite book/Faiths & Pantheons|122}}</ref>
*Followers of [[Tyr]] perform the ritual of [[Seeing Justice]], at which a giant [[warhammer]] appears above the congregation glowing white hot.<ref name="FA-170">{{Cite book/Faiths & Avatars|170}}</ref><ref name="FaP-80">{{Cite book/Faiths & Pantheons|80}}</ref>
*[[Waterdeep|Waterdhavians]] celebrate the [[Wintershield]] holiday by staying at home, sipping warmed [[cider]]s and [[herb]]-infused beverages and making plans for the new year, often consulting maps.<ref name="WDH5e-p184">{{Cite book/Waterdeep: Dragon Heist|184}}</ref>
*In [[987 DR]], an ill-fated [[dwarven]] mining expedition left [[Dennin's Delve|Dennin's Delve]] on the isle of [[Moray]] in the [[Moonshaes]] and headed west beneath the [[Trackless Sea]].<ref name="GHotR-114">{{Cite book/The Grand History of the Realms|114}}</ref>
*In [[1372 DR]], the floating enclave [[Thultanthar]] that escaped the [[Fall of Netheril]] was brought out of the [[Plane of Shadow]] by [[Galaeron Nihmedu]]. It appeared hovering over the ruins of [[Karse]] in the [[Dire Wood]] region of the [[High forest]].<ref name="PGtF-167">{{Cite book/Player's Guide to Faerûn|167}}</ref><ref name="GHotR-152">{{Cite book/The Grand History of the Realms|152}}</ref>
*In [[1373 DR]], the [[lich]] [[Sammaster]] successfully bound his [[phylactery]] to the [[Dracorage mythal]],<ref name="DoF-9">{{Cite book/Dragons of Faerûn|9}}</ref> and caused a [[Rage of Dragons|Rage]] that was not linked to the [[King-Killer Star]].<ref name="GHotR-153">{{Cite book/The Grand History of the Realms|153}}</ref>
*In [[1375 DR]], one of the [[Fall of Netheril|fallen]] [[Netherese]] enclaves, [[Negarath]], was discovered by the [[shadowdancer]] and [[rogue]], [[Fox-at-Twilight]].<ref name="GHotR-158">{{Cite book/The Grand History of the Realms|158}}</ref> There she met the [[goliath]] [[ranger]] [[Gargan]] and they escaped the clutches of a mad priest of [[Demogorgon]] named [[Gestal]].<ref name="DoM">{{Cite book/Depths of Madness}}</ref>

==On This Day==
* It is the [[Summer Solstice]].<ref name="FRCS3e-77">{{Cite book/Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 3rd edition|77}}</ref> It is the longest day of the year, with a northern location like [[Silverymoon]] seeing nearly 16 hours of daylight.<ref name="FRCS3e-p76">{{Cite book/Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 3rd edition|76}}</ref><ref group="note">In our world, [[Wikipedia:midsummer|midsummer]] celebrations are traditionally held around the [[Wikipedia:summer solstice|summer solstice]] (the longest day of the year), but the Realms's [[Calendar of Harptos]] has Midsummer a full month and a half after, owing to its summer solstice being the traditional start of summer. Despite this, many sources have still presumed Midsummer to be on or near the summer solstice, as evidenced by dates, mentions of the solstice, or it being the longest day of the year. Holding the Calendar of Harptos as standard, this wiki assumes these other Midsummers to be local variations. This article will document general summer solstice lore and Midsummers specifically dated to the summer solstice. Other Midsummers will be documented on their respective pages.</ref>

*In [[1371 DR]], the [[Sharn Wall]] keeping the [[phaerimm]] trapped beneath [[Anauroch]] was breached during a battle between [[Galaeron Nihmedu]] and [[Melegaunt Tanthul]] by the interaction of [[Weave]] magic and [[Shadow Weave]] magic.<ref name="PGtF-167,170">{{Cite book/Player's Guide to Faerûn|167, 170}}</ref>
*In [[1375 DR]], Lolth's Champion, [[Selvetarm]], was killed by [[Cavatina Xarann]]<ref name="SotW3">{{Cite book/Sacrifice of the Widow}}</ref> wielding the [[Crescent Blade]].<ref name="GHotR-158">{{Cite book/The Grand History of the Realms|158}}</ref>
*In [[1375 DR]], drow mages of [[Vhaeraun]] performed a [[High magic|High Magic]] ritual for the first time since the [[Descent of the Drow]] (circa [[-10000 DR|–10000 DR]]), which opened a gateway to [[Eilistraee]]'s realm in [[Arvandor]]. The Masked Lord attempted to assassinate his sister, but failed and was killed by her instead.<ref name="GHotR-158" /><ref group="note">''[[The Grand History of the Realms]]'' explicitly says that Vhaeraun's assassination attempt failed and Eilistraee killed him. However, in [http://forum.candlekeep.com/topic.asp?TOPIC_ID=19841&whichpage=22#476639 one of his answers], [[Ed Greenwood]] suggests that Eilistraee actually spared her brother's life. The Dark Maiden defeated Vhaeraun with the indirect help of her ally [[Mystra (Midnight)|Mystra]], as the [[Weave]] frustrated the Masked Lord's magic while enhancing Eilistraee's. The goddess temporarily took her brother's portfolio, and trapped his sentience in the Weave, where it was enfolded in a dream by Mystra. The Lady of Mysteries did that to ensure that the two drow siblings would survive the cataclysm that she knew was coming—the [[Spellplague]]—in which she would be "killed" to renew the Weave, and magic would go wild. After Mystra and the Weave were completely restored in 1487 DR, the goddess of magic could finally give Eilistraee her own lost power and do the same with Vhaeraun, after having awakened him from his dream.</ref>
